apis.agentUse: Use for any current-weather or short-forecast question once coordinates are known.
apis.description: Current weather and forecasts for any coordinates. No key, generous free tier.
apis.name: Open-Meteo Forecast
apis.responseNotes: Returns current conditions plus hourly arrays. Pair with the geocoding API to turn a city name into coordinates.

apis.agentUse: Use first whenever the user names a city but no coordinates.
apis.description: Turn a place name into coordinates, country, and timezone.
apis.name: Open-Meteo Geocoding
apis.responseNotes: results[] with latitude, longitude, country, admin1, timezone, population.

apis.agentUse: Use for word-finding, thesaurus, and writing-assistance questions.
apis.description: Word-finding engine: words related in meaning, sound, or spelling, with scores and definitions.
apis.name: Datamuse Word Finder
apis.responseNotes: Array of {word, score, defs[]}. Use ml= for meaning, sl= for sounds-like, sp= for spelling patterns.

apis.agentUse: Use for background explanations; always cite the article title.
apis.description: Encyclopedia extracts and search over Wikipedia articles.
apis.name: Wikipedia (MediaWiki API)
apis.responseNotes: query.pages with plain-text intro extract. The origin=* parameter enables CORS.

apis.agentUse: Use for tech-news discovery and community sentiment snapshots.
apis.description: Full-text search over Hacker News stories and comments with points and dates.
apis.name: Hacker News Search (Algolia)
apis.responseNotes: hits[] with title, url, points, num_comments, created_at.

apis.agentUse: Use for literature discovery and 'recent papers about X' questions.
apis.description: Search 250M+ scholarly works: titles, authors, venues, citation counts, open-access links.
apis.name: OpenAlex Works
apis.responseNotes: results[] plus meta.count. Abstracts are inverted indexes; prefer title/venue/citations for summaries.

apis.agentUse: Use to resolve or verify citations and DOIs.
apis.description: Bibliographic metadata for DOIs: titles, authors, journals, publication dates.
apis.name: Crossref Works
apis.responseNotes: message.items[] with DOI and title arrays.

apis.agentUse: Use for authoritative country and indicator data.
apis.description: Country metadata and development indicators (population, GDP, etc.) from the World Bank.
apis.name: World Bank API
apis.responseNotes: Two-element array: pagination meta + country records. Indicator endpoint: /v2/country/{code}/indicator/SP.POP.TOTL?format=json

apis.agentUse: Use for currency conversion context; state the rate date.
apis.description: Daily foreign-exchange reference rates from the European Central Bank.
apis.name: Frankfurter FX Rates
apis.responseNotes: rates object keyed by currency code, plus date. Rates are daily, not intraday.

apis.agentUse: Use for recent seismic activity questions; compute max/mean magnitude.
apis.description: GeoJSON feed of recent earthquakes (magnitude 4.5+, past week).
apis.name: USGS Earthquake Feed
apis.responseNotes: GeoJSON FeatureCollection; features[].properties has mag, place, time. Large payload — summarize, do not dump.

apis.agentUse: Use for book discovery and reading-list building.
apis.description: Search books by title, author, or subject; editions, authors, first publish year.
apis.name: Open Library Search
apis.responseNotes: docs[] with bibliographic fields; numFound for totals.

apis.agentUse: Use for open-source discovery; warn about the unauthenticated rate limit.
apis.description: Search public GitHub repositories by keyword, language, and stars. Unauthenticated rate limit applies (10 search requests/minute).
apis.name: GitHub Repository Search
apis.responseNotes: items[] with full_name, stargazers_count, description, html_url.

apis.agentUse: Use for a fun live-data demo and 'where is the ISS' questions.
apis.description: Live position, velocity, and visibility of the International Space Station.
apis.name: Where The ISS At

apis.agentUse: Use for demos and quizzes; decode HTML entities before display.
apis.description: Trivia questions with categories and difficulty. Good for testing agent tool calls.
apis.name: Open Trivia Database
apis.responseNotes: results[] with question, correct_answer, incorrect_answers (HTML-encoded text).

apis.agentUse: Use for demos and structured-JSON analysis practice.
apis.description: Pokemon data: types, abilities, stats, sprites. A reliable, well-documented demo API.
apis.name: PokeAPI
apis.responseNotes: Large object; pick types, abilities, stats, height, weight for summaries.

apis.agentUse: Use only for testing the runtime's fetch/analyze pipeline; label results as fake demo data.
apis.description: Fake REST API for prototyping: posts, users, todos. Data is fictional — never present it as real.
apis.name: JSONPlaceholder
apis.responseNotes: Single post object with userId, title, body.

apis.agentUse: Use as a minimal end-to-end smoke test for live calls.
apis.description: One random piece of advice per call. Tiny payload, good smoke test.
apis.name: Advice Slip
apis.responseNotes: slip.advice string. Responses may be cached by the provider for a few seconds.

apis.agentUse: Use for demos only; keep tone appropriate to the user's request.
apis.description: Random Chuck Norris jokes by category. Another tiny, reliable smoke-test API.
apis.name: Chuck Norris Jokes
apis.responseNotes: value string plus categories and url.

note: Curated free public APIs that work from a browser with no API key. All endpoints are GET and CORS-enabled at the time of writing. Rate limits still apply; check each provider's docs.
